nodes.text:
Is bird flu going to become a pandemic? What is HMPV?

AMA's Vice President of Science, Medicine and Public Health, Andrea Garcia, JD, MPH, discusses the "mystery virus" human metapneumovirus, that HMPV is not new, and shares trends in seasonal influenza and COVID-19 cases. https://t.co/QABVmhKryw

nodes.author: neilnicholson
nodes.text: Also covering the latest bird flu news of H5N9 on a California duck farm, as well as a raw pet food recall and the dangers of H5N1 for dogs and cats. American Medical Association CXO Todd Unger hosts. https://t.co/FNji0e3f9z
